change: Atomic encrypted history page references and traversal progress

initialCompile.reason: A cross-module nullable property could not be smart-cast; capture the next position in a local val before validation.

notes: Eleven transactional storage cases execute separately on real SQLite and IndexedDB, including overlap, first-page and later lost commit responses, cancellation, concurrent writes, account replacement, reauthentication, ciphertext/index tampering and missing keys over inactive traversal-only records.

Every page stages up to 20 validated references with its next position under one expected generation/revision. Empty advancing and terminal pages preserve all prior references. No reference resolution or original-content acknowledgement is performed.

Provider-device/room/account scope is authenticated, temporary content/index key bytes are cleared, and the existing original-history key format is unchanged. A separately authenticated partition uses that same credential safely.
The 141-reference indexed traversal case exceeds message-outbox capacity without a full partition scan; it is not production capacity or disk quota acceptance.

The new storage port resolves through application DI without starting network or key I/O. Live admitted page acquisition, provider-reference resolution, coordinated SDK reopening and Chat UI remain next.

No new actual-SDK run was required for this storage-only increment. The unchanged provider-reader proof at 3cc585b2/26796a33 has separate evidence; current behavior is checked using real encrypted SQLite/IndexedDB and full app builds.
